---
title: "The five phases of the analytical lifecycle"
description: "Go to the phase you are in, from scoping to review."
toc: false
---

The NHSBSA uses a five-phase analytical lifecycle to plan, produce, assure, communicate and review
analysis. The lifecycle supports a consistent approach while ensuring lessons learned are carried
forward into future work.

## The lifecycle

{{< include /guidance/_partials/diagram-lifecycle.qmd >}}
